summary: The terminal face (0288: no off-line zero with positive height above WinC.tPT2 = 3,000,175,332,800; given the cited census, RH q <-> terminalFace q) is attacked from three machine-verifiable angles. (1) FACE IDENTITY: the face is the SAME object as the endpoint's own terminal face - the hOff38PT2 premise of RHEnd.rh_program78_stripfront_mach_unified38_PT2 (no off-pair in 0 < d0 <= 3/8 above tPT2): [Z78] + that premise implies terminalFace (RHEnd.faceIdentity_z78_plus_unified38; Z78.offPairD0le forces every off-pair into d0 <= 3/8), and terminalFace + census implies it in the other direction (RHEnd.faceIdentity_terminalFace_gives_unified38; conjugation as in 0288, the d0 <= 3/8 side condition is not needed, the clauses cover every d0). 0286's 'one object' reconciliation is hereby a machine-verified theorem in both directions; the route-(b) face zero (d0 = 0.3747729897) sits INSIDE the unified38 band (d0 <= 0.375). (2) WIRE DEAD END: the W2/A1 wire (W2B3.a1_universal_wire, A1G.a1_growth_wire/a1_explicit_wire with the data-free ceiling G_explicit = 0.111 log T + 0.275 log log T + 2.45, CITED Trudgian A1G-5) bounds the kernel discrepancy by (G_explicit(frontier) + 1)*(17/8) on the far side (g1 >= 2t). A1G.a1_wire_no_uniform_defect_bound proves this quantity has NO uniform bound in the frontier: no C with (G_explicit g + 1)*(17/8) <= C for all g >= 4 (via the new A1G.face_unbounded_ge4 strengthening: for every K there is T >= 4 with K < G_explicit T). Consequence: the W2 wire closes at fixed data frontiers where (G+1)*(17/8) is still a finite small number (3e10: ~14.9 < 16, a1_zerofree_frontier) but its all-heights closure would need exactly the uniform O(1) form the theorem denies - equivalently the ABSOLUTE A1 clause (one K over all zeros), which E19 F1/F2 filed PROBABLY FALSE. The W2 wire is a FINITE-HEIGHT machine; it cannot close the face. (3) THE REFRAME (corrects the 0286/0288 truth-value attribution): the OPEN OBJECT that 'completing RH' reduces to (0288) is the FACE itself - probably TRUE (it IS RH above 3e12). The absolute A1 clause is the INPUT the wire method would need - probably FALSE. They were conflated as 'one object probably false'; accurately they are goal vs method, and the method is the wrong tool for the face. The face MENU (named sufficient conditions, each with a 2026 literature verdict): [M1] 0276 gate (pointwise per-piece S-bound < c*(t), in tree T4OffLO, implication valid, mechanism audit dead 0277/0284); [M2] theta = infinity lane: Ratios conjecture -> theta = infinity -> RH (Bettin-Gonek, Mathematika 63 (2017) 29-33, arXiv:1604.02740; theta = infinity = the mollified second moments stay bounded for mollifiers of ARBITRARY polynomial length T^theta, the Farmer framework) - the best-named live 2026 lane (2605.24363 extends the theorem to automorphic L-functions); [M3] S-route: STRUCTURALLY DEAD (best unconditional upper O(log t): Backlund/Trudgian A1G-5 explicit 0.111 log T + 0.275 log log T + 2.45, Iviac 0.1013 log T for large T; under RH Selberg/Littlewood C log t / log log t with C > 0.372 (Soundararajan); the omegas say the true maximal order GROWS - unconditionally (log t/log log t)^(1/3) (Littlewood/Ramachandra), under RH Bondarenko-Seip sqrt(log t * log log log t / log log t)); [M4] zero-free regions: WRONG SIDE (approach Re = 1, never 1/2; a region reaching Re >= 1/2 above tPT2 IS the face - tautology); [M5] frontier extension: finite, in tree (0287 WinC.noOffLineBelowPT engine; the A1G-5 machinery is uniform in height), every verified frontier H' machine-verified-shrinks the face to above H' - the only lane that SHRINKS the face with machine-verified steps, and its limit H' -> infinity needs an M2/M3-type mechanism.

build.notes: Lean pitfalls hit and fixed in 0289: (a) unannotated `by norm_num : 0 < 4` silently types as a NAT inequality - needs the (0 : Real) < 4 ascription (E17 pitfall, recurred); (b) `simpa` will not reduce `4 - 1` to `3` on reals - use calc with an explicit norm_num step; (c) calc mixing strict and non-strict steps infers the STRICT final relation - bridge the first step with le_of_lt when the target is <=; (d) `le_div_iff` is not in scope in this tree - do divisions via mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right with the reciprocal + div_eq_mul_inv, or avoid division entirely (0289's final proofs are division-free); (e) `|a : Real|` type ascription inside abs-notation does not parse - ascription on the operand (|(a : Real) - b|), matching P12Uniform.offPair's own form; (f) set-with-eq + linarith: WinC.tPT2's positivity is not visible to linarith - `norm_num [WinC.tPT2]` first (same pattern as the existing unified38_PT2 instance).

literatureAudit2026.thetaInf: Bettin-Gonek (Mathematika 63 (2017) 29-33, arXiv:1604.02740): the theta = infinity conjecture (Conrey-Ghosh/Farmer: the mollified second moments of zeta remain bounded for mollifiers M_N of ARBITRARY polynomial length T^theta, N = T^theta; the Levinson I_N asymptotic extends to theta -> infinity) implies RH. Chain from the Conrey 2017 Bristol lecture: Ratios conjecture -> theta = infinity -> RH. 2026 status ALIVE and ACTIVE: arXiv:2605.24363 'The theta = infinity Conjecture and the Riemann Hypothesis for Automorphic L-functions' extends the implication to cuspidal automorphic L(GL_m), and the unconditional Levinson-type proportion record stands at at least 2/3 of zeros on the line (Conrey-Chandee-Farb-Young).
literatureAudit2026.sRoute: Best unconditional UPPER bound for S(t): O(log t) (Backlund method; explicit CITED Trudgian A1G-5 (Math. Comp. 81:1053-1061 (2012), arXiv:1208.5846): |S(T)| <= 0.111 log T + 0.275 log log T + 2.45 for T >= e; Iviac (arXiv:1010.4596) sharpens the asymptotic constant to 0.1013 log T for sufficiently large T). Under RH: Selberg/Littlewood C log t / log log t, the order never improved, only the constant: C = 1.119 (Ramachandra-Sankaranarayanan) -> 0.67 (Fujii) -> any C > (1+lambda_0)/4 = 0.372 with lambda_0 = 0.4912... the root of e^-lambda = lambda + lambda^2/2 (Soundararajan; CGG arXiv:math/0511092 Theorem 4.2). OMEGAS (lower bounds, the true maximal order): unconditionally S(t) = omega_pm((log t / log log t)^(1/3)) (Littlewood 1926 / Ramachandra); under RH the Bondarenko-Seip conditional omega |S(t)| >> sqrt(log t * log log log t / log log t) holds at arbitrarily large t (arXiv:1704.06158). VERDICT: every route through an ABSOLUTE (uniform, non-growing) bound on S is structurally dead - S's true maximal order grows; the wire's all-heights closure needed exactly such a bound (0289 wire dead end); the growth-form wire cannot (a1_wire_no_uniform_defect_bound).
